reuse_cost.source: Betevé 2012: value of Guinardó plot swap, earmarked for urbanising Can Batlló (not a cost estimate)

indicators.source: Barri la Bordeta 2011 fact sheet; registered unemployed / total population (%), not the unemployment rate (1,247 / 18,431; BCN 108,624 / 1,615,985)

temporary.type: self-managed neighbourhood facilities: library, auditorium, bar, workshops, community garden
temporary.agreement_type: cession of use (cessió d'ús) of Bloc Onze by the City Council, June 2011; later 50-year concession of c. 13,000 m² to the Associació Espai Comunitari i Veïnal Autogestionat de Can Batlló
temporary.funding: renovation of Bloc Onze financed by the City Council; volunteer work; self-financing decided by the assembly

actors.name: Plataforma Can Batlló és pel barri

regeneration_cost.source: Construible 2021: park phase 1 initial budget (5.4 M from private plot owners); total with phase 2 24.8 M EUR; ReHousIn 2026 gives 12.6 M / 21 M (unreconciled)

after.community_objections: Conflict between the City Council and the ECVA over the scope and management of phase 2 and the future of Bloc 11; ECVA assemblies described as exclusionary by some residents; concerns about rising rents and new-build housing around the site (highest new-contract rents in 2023); departure of the >200 small businesses in 2012 after the land transfer (ReHousIn 2026, pp. 15, 17, 48, 53, 55; Betevé 2012).

actors.name: Espai Comunitari i Veïnal Autogestionat Can Batlló (ECVA)

after.zoning: MPGM Can Batlló-Magòria, definitively approved 28 July 2017 (qualifications 5, 6b, 6b/p, 6b/18, 7b, 18, 18/HS)
